hinge.title: Decide whether a change is desirable or undesirable by using the situation and purpose, not the change name alone.
node_labels: Matter: materials, particles, mixtures and change

intelligence.enrichment: A change is desirable when it is useful in a situation and undesirable when it is harmful or unwanted in that situation. The purpose and situation determine whether the same general kind of change is judged desirable or undesirable. The learner judges desirable or undesirable change by the usefulness, harm, or purpose in the stated situation. A change has one fixed value label, so the same kind of change is always desirable or always undesirable.
